title: ANDS Studio — Module builder & document authoring
walkthrough:
Opening a module of a dossier first shows "Loading dossier…"; if the module id is unknown, a notice reads "Module not found." The workspace then splits into three columns: a section tree on the left, a section panel in the middle, and a sidebar on the right.

The left tree is headed by the module title. Group rows show a section number and name (for example "1.2 · …"). Each selectable section row carries a status glyph — ○ (to do), ◐ (partly done), ✓ (done), ⊘ (not applicable) — the section number, and the title. Sections that support AI drafting show a "✦AI" badge whose tooltip reads "This section supports interactive AI drafting — you review and approve before anything is saved". Every row also has a "req" or "opt" badge; hovering shows either "Required: Health Canada expects this section in your submission type" or "Optional: include when it applies to your product; otherwise Mark N/A with a reason". Sections that do not apply are collapsed under an expandable line, "Not required for this generic (N)", listing each with a ⊘ mark. The first applicable document section is selected automatically.

The middle panel opens with an eyebrow line like "Module 1 · Section 1.2.2 · required", the section title, and a purpose sentence. A boxed explainer titled "What Health Canada needs here" gives guidance text plus metadata such as "Format: PDF", "Bilingual: EN + FR" when relevant, and a link "Health Canada guidance ↗". Not-applicable sections show "This section is not applicable for a generic ANDS on the comparative-BE pathway — nothing to file here." Backbone sections with no actions show "This section is generated automatically as part of the eCTD backbone (index.xml / ca-regional.xml) — there is nothing to upload. Open the Application Viewer to see it."

Documents already attached appear as rows with an icon (📄 uploaded, ✦ generated, 💬 AI-drafted), an optional EN/FR label, the filename, a size like "1.2 MB", a truncated checksum ("md5 ab12cd34…"), a "Download" link, and a provenance chip: "uploaded" (tooltip: "Uploaded by your team — content is exactly what you provided."), "authored in-app" (tooltip: "Produced in-app from your entries by a deterministic Health Canada template."), or "AI-assisted — review before filing" (tooltip: "Drafted interactively with the AI assistant under your direction. Recorded in the audit trail. Review against the Health Canada guidance before filing.").

Below sits an action tab bar showing only the actions each section supports: "⬆ Upload", "✦ Author in-app", "⊘ Mark N/A". Upload shows a dropzone reading "Drop a file or click to choose" with the accepted formats underneath (e.g. "PDF / DOCX"); bilingual sections show two dropzones labeled "English (EN)" and "Français (FR)". While transferring it reads "Uploading…", and a screen-reader announcement confirms "filename placed in 1.2.2". "Author in-app" on AI-draftable sections first offers two modes, "💬 Draft with AI" and "✦ Sample & edit". The sample form states: "Pre-filled with a realistic sample from your dossier — edit every field to your product, then author. Fields marked sample are worked examples to replace." Fields carry labels such as "Drug product", "Canadian Reference Product (brand)", "AUC 90% CI", some tagged "sample". Buttons read "Author {section title} →" ("Authoring…" while busy) and "Review vs Health Canada". The review result says "Health Canada review: no blocking content gaps." or "N to fix, M to check.", listing findings marked ✗ or ⚠ with a suggested edit and an "HC guidance ↗" link. "Mark N/A" asks "Why is this section not applicable? (optional)" with placeholder "e.g. no prior related applications" and a "Mark this section N/A" button ("Saving…" while busy); once saved, the panel shows "Marked N/A — {reason}." (just "Marked N/A." when no reason was given).

Section 1.2.2 additionally shows a fees widget: "Current ANDS review fee (fiscal year): $amount CUR", possibly "— waived (first-ever submission)." or a small-business payable amount with a percentage reduction, plus "Right to Sell (annual): $amount — due date." Two checkboxes read "Small-business status is granted (before filing)" and "Fee payment is arranged". Section 1.3.1 adds a collapsible "XML Product Monograph — build & validate (HC mandate is phasing in for generics)" with an EN/FR selector, a "Build & validate XML PM" button ("Building…" while running), a "⬇ pm-en.xml" download chip (shown after a build; named pm-en.xml or pm-fr.xml per the selected language), and a result of "✓ XML PM validates against the stylesheet package." or "✗ N finding(s): …".

The right sidebar includes a card stating "Module 1 — {name}", a progress bar, "3/9 required sections complete" (counts vary), possibly "N item(s) still needed to file (documents, fee, or validation).", and three flags: "Documents", "Fee", "Valid eCTD", each marked ✓ or ○. Below sits "Collaboration": an "Inbox" button (showing "Inbox · N" when unread) toggles a list of notification subjects or "No notifications yet." The task area shows "No open tasks for this dossier." or task rows with title, assignee, optional "due {date}", and a "Done" button; completed count appears as "N completed". Inputs "New task title", "Assignee (email)" (pre-filled with the signed-in user's email), and a date picker feed an "Add task" button ("Adding…" while saving), disabled until title and assignee are filled. If the service fails, the pane shows "Collaboration unavailable — {error}".
